channel.title: Earning Money Online UK
channel.description: Practical UK money guides with real figures, honest maths and named sources. Make money, save money, side hustles, careers and buying decisions.

item.title: Capital Gains Tax on Shares and Crypto: The 31 December 2026 Deadline
item.description: Sold shares or crypto in 2025 to 2026? Report a gain to HMRC by 31 December 2026 and pay by 31 January 2027. The GBP 3,000 allowance and 18% or 24% rates explained.

item.title: Are E-Bikes Worth It in the UK? The Law, the Battery Bill and the Fire Risk
item.description: Yes, if you ride 3 to 15 miles and can charge it safely. The UK limit is still 250W and 15.5mph, and a branded battery now costs about £410 to replace.

item.title: Best Cashback Credit Card UK: The Maths the Adverts Never Show You
item.description: The best free cashback card pays 0.5% on your first £10,000 a year, so most households earn £30 to £150. Work out your own number before you apply.

item.title: Christmas Bank Holiday Pay in 2026: Do You Get Paid on 25 and 28 December?
item.description: Bank holidays do not have to be paid leave. Employers can count them inside your 28 days, so 25 and 28 December may cost you holiday. Check your contract.

item.title: Your First Home scheme: is a 2.5% deposit worth the 20% equity loan?
item.description: Your First Home needs a 2.5% deposit and a 20% equity loan, interest free for 5 years. Applications open February 2027. Here are the sums and the catches.

item.title: Remote Jobs UK No Degree: What Is Real, What Pays and How to Get Hired
item.description: Remote jobs in the UK with no degree: 8 roles that really hire, pay from the £12.71 National Living Wage, and the scams that target this search.

item.title: Side Hustle With a Full Time Job: How to Fit It In Without Burning Out
item.description: Running a side hustle with a full time job? Plan 6 to 10 hours a week in two blocks, check your contract, and know HMRC's £1,000 trading allowance.

item.title: Side Hustle Tax Rules UK: The £1,000 Allowance Now, and the £3,000 One From April 2027
item.description: Side hustle tax rules UK: the trading allowance is £1,000 of gross sales for 2026 to 27 and triples to £3,000 from 6 April 2027. Who must tell HMRC now.

item.title: Print on Demand UK: The Real Profit Per T-Shirt in 2026
item.description: A £22 print on demand t-shirt sold on Etsy in the UK leaves about £9.60 after Printful and Etsy fees, and far less with ads. See every line of the sums.

item.title: Making Money From Photography in the UK: The Six Real Routes
item.description: Making money from photography in the UK: six routes ranked by speed, the £1,484 average wedding spend, what stock really pays, and the tax rules.

item.title: Password Manager UK: Is the Free One Enough?
item.description: Password manager UK guide: Bitwarden and Proton Pass are free on unlimited devices, and Bitwarden Premium is about £17.50 a year. When paying is worth it.

item.title: Low Standing Charge Tariff UK: Who Actually Saves, and Who Pays More
item.description: A low standing charge tariff cuts about £150 a year in daily charges but raises unit rates. Here is the break even, with sums, for UK homes in 2026.

item.title: Coffee Cart Side Hustle in the UK: What It Takes and What It Pays
item.description: A coffee cart side hustle in the UK needs council food registration 28 days before you trade, often a street licence too. Real costs, pay and tax, checked.

item.title: Does Growing Your Own Vegetables Save Money in the UK?
item.description: Growing your own vegetables saves money only on the right crops. Raspberries were £13.58 a kg wholesale, carrots 60p. See what to grow and what to skip.

item.title: Freelance Day Rate UK: How to Set Yours Without Undercharging
item.description: Set your freelance day rate in the UK from the profit you need, not a salary. Developer contracts median £500 a day. See the maths and a worked example.

item.title: DIY Jobs to Save Money at Home, and the Ones to Never Attempt
item.description: DIY jobs to save money at home in the UK, what Part P lets you do and why gas is off limits. Each 5% of gas saved is worth £47.82 a year at today's cap.

item.title: New subscription rules are due on 1 January 2027: what changes when you cancel or a plan renews
item.description: New UK subscription rules are due 1 January 2027: a 14 day renewal cooling off, renewal reminders and online cancellation. It is still draft law. Here is the detail.

item.title: UGC Creator UK: What Brands Actually Pay Per Video
item.description: Billo pays UK creators $40 for a 30 second video, about £29.86. How to price your own UGC, the ASA ad rules, and why HMRC taxes free products.

item.title: The Trading Allowance Triples To £3,000 From April 2027: What It Means For Your Side Hustle
item.description: The trading allowance triples from £1,000 to £3,000 on 6 April 2027. Who stops filing a tax return, allowance or expenses, and what platforms still report.

item.title: Sell Your Old Phone Before Christmas: Trade In vs Resale UK
item.description: We priced an iPhone 15 on 15 November: Apple up to £305 credit, Back Market £250 cash, musicMagpie £247.50, O2 Recycle up to £244. Which pays most, and when.

item.title: Savings Tax Rises To 24% In April 2027: What To Do Before Then
item.description: Tax on savings interest rises to 24%, 44% and 49% from 6 April 2027, but the cash ISA stays at £20,000. Who pays, and the moves worth making before April.

item.title: Rent Out Your Car in the UK: What Peer to Peer Car Sharing Really Pays
item.description: Turo lets UK hosts keep 60% to 80% of the trip price, but cars on finance are barred. Our £40 a day example keeps about £32 to £50 a month after tax and wear.

item.title: Landlord Tax From April 2027: What the 24% Property Income Rate Costs a Typical Let
item.description: Rental profit is due to be taxed at 24%, 44% or 49% from April 2027. Our sums show a basic rate landlord pays £208 more a year and a higher rate one £240 more.

item.title: £100 Household Energy Payment: Who Gets It and When
item.description: The £100 Household Energy Payment goes to council tax bands A to D in England from January 2027. Pay by Direct Debit and it should arrive with no claim.

item.title: Get Paid to Use Less Electricity This Winter: What It Really Pays
item.description: Saving Sessions and the grid's Demand Flexibility Service pay pennies per kWh you cut at peak. Last full winter averaged about 48p per signed up home.

item.title: Get Paid to Train AI in the UK: What It Really Pays
item.description: Prolific's floor is £6 an hour and it recommends £9. AI annotation sites quote $15 to $150+ in dollars. What UK workers really earn, tax and scams.

item.title: Black Friday 2026 Fake Discounts: How To Check A Real Deal
item.description: Black Friday is 27 November 2026. Which? found 83% of tracked deals were the same price or cheaper at other times. How to check a was price in five minutes.

item.title: Dividend Tax UK: What You Owe Above The £500 Allowance
item.description: Dividends over the GBP 500 allowance are taxed at 10.75% for basic rate taxpayers in 2026 to 2027. What GBP 5,000 and GBP 10,000 cost, and when to tell HMRC.

item.title: Christmas 2026 Benefit Payment Dates: Who Is Paid Early
item.description: Universal Credit due 25 to 28 December is paid on Thursday 24 December, and 1 to 3 January on Thursday 31 December. Check your State Pension day too.

item.title: The water tariff that is cheaper until it suddenly is not, and where the line sits
item.description: Severn Trent's Water Smart trial charges three rates by monthly use. On 2026/27 rates it is cheaper up to about 12.5 cubic metres a month, then dearer, fast.
